Synopsis:
This dialog is started by talking to the Butcher character in the Colony. The player may ask the Butcher questions or recruit them as a temporary follower inside the Colony. Alternatively, this dialog runs through a flag in case the player has already met the Butcher, or if the Butcher was recruited as a follower. The Butcher sounds eerily vacant unless otherwise specified, his mind destroyed by his time in Colony.

Cluster Contexts:
- COL_Kitchen_Butcher.json: You find the Butcher inside the Mind Flayer Colony; his mind has been hollowed by the Collective and he speaks in an eerie, vacant way. Off‑screen the party has already pushed through violent encounters toward this area, so companions (Lae'zel, Daisy or others) may be at your side and will react to his condition and the mounting psychic/Absolute presence. The scene can play as a first meeting or as a repeat/after‑recruitment interaction, and one branch offers treating him as a temporary follower while another treats him as an irredeemable thrall (some companions even urge killing him). The brief narrator lines emphasize that no will sparks behind his eyes and that he largely echoes the Collective’s commands.
- COL_Morgue_Us.json: Default dialogue with Us while they are in the Colony. Us is either locked in a cage in the Morgue, trying to sneak away from the Butcher, or thanking you for saving them, after which they will disappear.
- LOW_PhilgravesMansion_Lumbar.json: Dialog for one of the zombie beggars. After player talks to Father Carrion and has been tasked to kill them, they will react to this and either run to warn their leader, Thrumbo, or confront player. The following states are one-liners and hasmets for each possible quest state (meeting with thrumbo, outside house and inside father carrion's house once fully killed.)
- LOW_PhilgravesMansion_ZombieBeggar_Sacrum.json: Dialog for one of the zombie beggars. After player talks to Father Carrion and has been tasked to kill them, they will react to this and either run to warn their leader, Thrumbo, or confront player. The following states are one-liners and hasmets for each possible quest state (meeting with thrumbo, outside house and inside father carrion's house once fully killed.)
- WYR_Windmill_Mindflayer.json: Windmill mindflayer asks player to bring it a corpse to feed on.Speaker 3 is an optional non-illithid player that will briefly be pointed out as potential food in the conversation.

context: You find the Butcher inside the Mind Flayer Colony after the party has already pushed through violent encounters to reach this area; companions (for example Lae'zel or others) may be standing nearby and will react to the scene. His mind has been hollowed by the Collective—he speaks in an eerie, vacant way and largely echoes the Collective’s commands, with narrator lines emphasizing that no will sparks behind his eyes. This conversation can play as a first meeting, a repeat interaction, or as the branch where the player recruits him as a temporary follower inside the Colony; an alternate branch treats him as an irredeemable thrall. Some companions may urge killing him rather than trying to save or recruit him.
